parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.status, c.last_message, c.last_message_at, c.message_count,
       c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.closed_at,
       u.name AS user_name, u.mobile AS user_mobile
FROM support__conversations c
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
WHERE (
  CASE
    WHEN ? = 'unanswered' THEN c.status IN ('open', 'pending')
    WHEN ? = '' THEN 1
    ELSE c.status = ?
  END
)
  AND (? = '' OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%') OR CAST(c.user_id AS CHAR) = ? OR c.last_message LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%'))
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
